statements.sql: SELECT call_index,purpose,request,sha256_text(request) AS request_text_sha256 FROM runtime_model_calls WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=? AND call_index=?

SELECT decision_index,json_extract(action,'$.kind') AS kind,json_extract(action,'$.tool') AS tool,json_extract(action,'$.arguments') AS selected_arguments,sha256_text(action) AS action_text_sha256,json_extract(result,'$.status') AS status,json_extract(result,'$.operation_ref') AS operation_ref,json_extract(result,'$.result.job_ref') AS nested_job_ref,json_extract(result,'$.job_ref') AS top_job_ref FROM runtime_actions WHERE run_id=? AND episode_id=? AND decision_index=?
SELECT id,operation_key,request,sha256_text(request) AS request_text_sha256,state,remote_id,error_code FROM provider_jobs WHERE id=?
